data.name: Foruhar
data.gender_notes: Foruhar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'forud', meaning 'wise' and 'rich'. The name Foruhar symbolizes a wise and wealthy person. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the Prophet Solomon, who was known for his wisdom and wealth. The name Foruhar carries the meaning “Bright, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Foruhar usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of wisdom and wealth in Islamic tradition.
data.etymology: Foruhar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Foruhar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
